MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:
Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains
Polished technical communications
Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers
The TAM’s primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio.

They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB.

The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.
The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.
This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.
Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career
Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, focused on innovation and speed
Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
Work with exceptionally skilled people around the globe
Learn, contribute, and make a positive impact on the product and community
Cool things you’ll do
MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB
As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between
You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB
You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem
What you need
You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted

Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAM’s portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations)
Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience
The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability
Collaborator
Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met
Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will
Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts

Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high
Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method
Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos
Technical Expert
Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems
Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle
Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer
Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
Builder
Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDB’s technical relationship with marquee customers
Product evangelism
The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems

Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures
Microservices/Serverless architectures
CI/CD tools and approaches
Containerization, orchestration and management tools
Enterprise Identity platforms
Experience using or managing MongoDB
Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering
Success Measures
In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

About the opportunity
As an IT Solutions Engineer (Google Cloud) within N26 Internal IT, you will be the primary architect, engineer, and guardian of our Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) corporate ecosystem.
We aren’t looking for traditional system administrators. We need a modern, engineering-focused professional who treats our Google environment as a programmable platform. You will bridge the gap between corporate productivity, identity management, and cloud infrastructure—ensuring our global workforce is secure, highly automated, and empowered by next-generation AI integrations.

Infrastructure & Governance: Manage the full lifecycle of our enterprise Google Workspace organization. Design and maintain complex GCP project structures, organizational units (OUs), Cloud Identity, and Chrome Enterprise across the company.
Automation & Development: Eliminate manual overhead by building robust, custom automation workflows. Leverage Google Apps Script, Python, and REST APIs to seamlessly integrate Workspace with internal tools, HRIS platforms, and Identity providers.
Next-Gen Productivity: Lead the rollout, adoption, and ongoing optimization of Gemini Enterprise, driving organizational productivity through emerging AI capabilities.
Security & Compliance: Design and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules, Context-Aware Access (CAA), and secure BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) policies that balance "Security first" with "Employee Experience."
eDiscovery & Compliance: Serve as the technical owner for Google Vault. Define and manage data retention policies, execute precise legal holds, and lead matter-based exports to meet strict financial regulatory and audit requirements.

s.h: What you need to be successful
s.t:
Google Workspace & GCP Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience administering Google Workspace at an enterprise scale, combined with solid foundational knowledge of GCP (IAM hierarchies, Service Accounts, VPCs, and Organization Policies).
Automation Mindset: Proven track record of automating repetitive IT workflows using Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script, and interacting with RESTful APIs.
Infrastructure as Code Skills: Practical experience (or strong familiarity) using Terraform to manage SaaS or cloud environments.
Security & Identity Focus: Deep understanding of modern identity management, SAML/OIDC protocols, and Zero Trust security architectures (specifically Google’s Context-Aware Access and BeyondCorp models).
Chrome Enterprise Management: Proven experience configuring Chrome as a secure enterprise browser, including the deployment of Chrome Enterprise Premium security controls.
Analytical & Compliance-Minded: Familiarity with compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC2) and the operational workflows of Google Vault for legal and audit discovery.
Collaborative Spirit: Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into user-friendly solutions for a diverse global team.

Professional Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent security certifications.
Fintech Experience: Experience working in highly regulated industries (banking, fintech, or healthcare) with stringent data governance requirements.

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works.

Results that matter.
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

Modern authentication and authorization protocols ( OAuth 2.0, OIDC ).
Direct API management and endpoint testing using Auth0 Management & Authentication REST APIs .

Key Account Partnership & Influence

Masterfully apply technical expertise in Auth0 Customer Identity and developer-first architectures to solve complex identity challenges and influence customer strategy.

Prototyping, Technical Execution & Advocacy

Complex Problem Resolution: Dissect multi-faceted developer and architectural issues, proactively identify technical risks, and orchestrate effective solutions or escalations collaboratively with Customer Success and Engineering.
Advocate for customer technical needs within cross-functional product and engineering teams.

Generate repeatable code samples, Postman collections, architectural guides, and strategy assets for the global TAM team.
Mentor peers, upskilling team capability with a focus on developer SDKs, API integrations, and Auth0 extensibility.

Excellent communication skills, capable of speaking fluently with developer teams, software architects, and engineering leadership.
Comfortable performing live technical demonstrations, API troubleshooting in Postman, and whiteboarding complex system architecture.

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurateurs adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses that they love. As Toast continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced Solutions Engineer to help us continue to grow internationally expanding into mid - market and enterprise accounts.
Hybrid, London-based — with some travel to customer sites as needed.

Assist Sales teams in presenting the Toast product and platform to prospects and be able to demonstrate the value of a complete solution to each buying persona
Become a subject matter expert on Toast products with complete knowledge of the technologies, application software, and integrated partners, and future product roadmap
Work closely with Sales Enablement regionally to provide training and product expertise
Communicate with Toast product teams to clearly communicate gaps in product/market fit to drive strategic investments
Attend trade shows and other events as a Toast brand ambassador
Must have ability to work closely with Product Management, Sales Enablement, and Marketing teams
Drive cross functional collaboration across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
Use restaurant industry knowledge / experience to consult with prospects on how Toast can help them outperform their peers

s.h: Do you have the right ingredients
s.t:
Presentation Skills: Executive presence and the ability to articulate complex products and ideas with clarity, and handle complex customer communications fluently while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Strong understanding of APIs (coding skills not required)
Sales Experience: 3+ years of sales experience in a closing or closing support role within the Restaurant/Hospitality segment.
Collaborative: Highly collaborative, serving as a trusted partner to sales, onboarding, and product teams, with strong problem solving/troubleshooting skills.
Industry Experience: Must have experience with cloud POS systems, ideally within the Restaurant, Hospitality, or related industry. Experience with multi-location brands, enterprise/franchise IT systems, or complex organizational structures is highly desirable.
Must be willing to perform nationwide travel to support business needs.

s.h: Special Sauce (non-essential skills, nice to have)
s.t:
Hospitality Experience: Must have experience working in hospitality in some capacity, giving you the ability to understand the challenges our customers face quickly.

Must have the ability to work with minimal supervision: This role will require working independently as the first member of the team within the UK region.
AI at Toast
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality.

We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .
How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process
Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people.

We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
Our Approach to Hybrid Working
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast
People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success
At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
Apply today!
Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com .

When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! By comparing prices from major booking sites, we're making it easy for people to find hotels they want at a price they’ll love. In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry.

A career at trivago is a journey designed for people who crave continuous development and want to thrive in a high-performing team. Here you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!
Join us in making a difference
We have an exciting opportunity for a fixed-term role (approximately 1 year) , offering you the chance to make an immediate impact with our team.

Our Technical Account Management team plays a vital role in ensuring seamless technical integration and maximizing campaign performance for our key advertisers, working closely with Engineering, Product, and Sales.

As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be the trusted technical consultant for a portfolio of medium to large key accounts, with a focus on advertisers across Spain and Latin America.
Your expertise will bridge the gap between complex technical solutions and business growth, empowering partners to unlock their full potential on our platform.

At trivago, ambition and genuine support go hand in hand — we hold high standards and invest in each other's growth, which means you'll have the autonomy to shape initiatives, mentor colleagues, and solve sophisticated technical challenges that directly influence our advertisers' success. Ready to make your mark? We'd love to hear from you!

Manage and optimize a portfolio of approximately 20 medium to large key accounts with medium to high complexity, ensuring technical excellence and driving business growth.
Serve as the primary technical consultant for advertisers, evaluating and implementing API features, conversion tracking, and quality assurance initiatives that enhance campaign performance.
Proactively monitor search and conversion API performance for top accounts, conducting in-depth analyses and providing strategic recommendations for technical opportunities.
Lead internal knowledge-sharing sessions and provide expert technical support to Sales Account Management teams.
Act as the incident manager for advertiser-related business-critical issues, navigating complex troubleshooting scenarios and ensuring swift resolution to maintain advertiser trust.

Proven experience managing medium to large technical accounts with complex integration requirements, demonstrating strong relationship-building and consultative skills.
Technical knowledge of APIs, conversion tracking, URL-tracking systems, and campaign performance optimisation.
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to engage clearly and persuasively with advertisers and internal stakeholders across different levels.
Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to prepare in-depth campaign analyses, identify improvement opportunities, and translate technical insights into actionable business recommendations.
Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to prioritise initiatives and make decisions that impact broader team objectives.
A collaborative approach with experience refining workflows and contributing to process improvements that drive team efficiency.
A genuine learning mindset — you approach challenges with curiosity, seek out feedback, and continuously look for ways to develop and grow.
A performance mindset — you set ambitious goals for yourself and have the determination and resilience to follow through and achieve them.
An open and curious mindset toward AI tools and automation — you actively explore how AI can enhance your work and are excited to grow alongside evolving technologies.

Fluent Spanish skills (written and verbal), enabling you to build strong relationships with advertisers across Spain and Latin America.
Not ticking every box? We still want to hear from you . Apply, tell us what motivates you, and you could be a great match — now or in the future. Your application does not need to include a photo.

s.h: What you can look forward to
s.t:
As you grow, so do we.
This is why at trivago, we prioritize your development, offer personalized coaching through Nilo, and provide workshops, educational meetups, conferences, free online learning courses, and access to a fully-equipped campus library.
Moving to join us?
No problem. You can count on the visa support from our talent support team, a relocation package, interest-free newcomer loan, free language classes, regular team and company-wide events to build experiences together.
Life happens.
We offer self-determined vacation (with a minimum of 25 vacation days), flexible working hours, up to 2 work from home days weekly. Additionally you can work remotely from a different location, within Germany or selected countries abroad for up to 20 days per year. You also get free access to the Heycare platform for personalized nanny assistance, and an on-campus kids room.
Enjoy your office days.
Use your daily canteen budget to share lunch with colleagues in our canteen, help yourself to complimentary snacks and drinks in our kitchens, choose from a variety of fitness options with our on-site gym, sports classes, and Urban Sports Club membership , and enjoy the comfort of ergonomic desks and focused work areas.
Thank you for considering a career at trivago! Our commitment to fostering an inclusive and enriching environment for all talents is at the heart of what we do. We understand that embarking on a new job opportunity is a blend of excitement and curiosity. Should any questions arise before you apply, feel free to reach out to us at joinus@trivago.com . Join us in our mission to make a positive impact on global travel, w e look forward to your application!

We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!
The Solutions Engineer (SE) delivers technical sales and product consultancy services to NewBiz, partners and Customer Success. The goal for the SE is to be responsible for the free trials and to help increase win rate and deal size. The SE also helps with maintaining and increasing product knowledge in the NewBiz & CS departments as well as assisting with pre- and post-sales activities and tracking accordingly via Salesforce.

The SE is required to maintain a good balance in relation to product knowledge, focus on product reach and make sure that Trustpilot can close business by:
Set up and run new trials.
Participate in pre-sales activities coordinated by sales reps.
Coordinate pre-sales activities with allocated sales reps (sales teams).
Work closely together with Support, Customer Success, Sales Ops and New Bizz
Maintain and update trial reporting accordingly
Assist CS in technical solutions for upsells and renewals.
Enterprise prioritisation including troubleshooting. Refresher & scope training for trials & supporting modular trials on Ents accounts.
CS winback trials
Sales clinic. Personalised sessions looking with reps at hard-to-convert leads with technical blockers(e.g. Automation issues, lack of technical knowledge etc)
Automation health checklist; ensure self-inviter methods are used only as a last resort and all other automation methods are explored before passing to CS
Presales framework for deals over a certain value. Ensure the client knows what technology is being used, how long to automate & integrate.

Experience in a similar technical role.
A good understanding of e-commerce, social media, and SEO, ideally from a company working with SAAS or E-commerce.
Experience using Salesforce.
Have a good understanding of HTML and JavaScript.
Technical support and troubleshooting experience.
A doer who takes pride in providing a high level of service and delivering a consistent performance.
Ability to work in a team selling environment. You must enjoy working in a thriving environment and have an interest in supporting sales.
Self-motivated, goal-oriented with enthusiasm and commitment to achievement.
Experience and understanding of REST API or similar.(training provided)
Knowledge of scripting or other software development experience
A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops
Still unsure?
We want everyone to feel welcome at Trustpilot. We’re excited to hear about your experiences and how you can help us create a great culture for our team. So don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box - we’d still love to hear from you!

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
Join us at the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.
If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers.

As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture.

The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime.

You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

We are looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer to join our partnerships team in EMEA. This role will lead enablement and pre-sales motions with Vercel's solution and consulting partners (SIs and GSIs) across the region, with a primary focus on the DACH market. Partner Solutions Engineers work with partner engineering, sales, and product teams to grow adoption of Vercel's products and build strong technical relationships.
A key focus in this role will be growing partner-delivered capacity in the DACH region: running Vercel's partner certification program, creating and delivering technical enablement and workshops, and supporting pre-sales motions where partners are engaged. Fluency in German and/or French is essential; this is a spoken, partner-facing role.
This role will serve as a developer advocate for Vercel across solution and consulting partners. You will be the expert on building and delivering with Vercel products, including AI and agent workloads, and will establish best practices, author guides, lead workshops and hackathons, and build solutions for partner communities and Vercel teams.
Partner Solutions Engineers require a strong web development background, especially in frontend development, cloud infrastructure, networking, and modern application development. Strong coordination skills across multiple partners and time zones are essential, as is building lasting relationships with practice leads, delivery teams, and executives.
This is an in-person (hybrid) position that will require you to be based in Vercel's London or Berlin office with a required 3 days per week in office.

Serve as subject matter expert on Vercel and Next.js to partner engineering teams and leadership across EMEA.
Run Vercel's partner certification program in the region: deliver certification workshops, review certification projects, and guide partner engineers through the program.
Create and deliver technical training and enablement on Next.js and Vercel best practices, including building agents and AI applications on Vercel.
Deliver one-to-many technical workshops for partner engineering teams, and author the workshop content behind them.
Run and support partner hackathons that build partner skills and surface joint solutions.
Provide pre-sales support where partners are engaged: proofs of concept, technical deep dives, and deal unblocking alongside Vercel's sales and sales engineering teams.
Serve as the main technical contact for SIs and GSIs in the region, building lasting relationships with their engineering teams and practice leadership.
Build templates and solutions that equip partner communities with the best practices on delivering with Vercel.

You are passionate about building first-class user experiences on the web.
You have a strong understanding of web architecture, frontend development, and serverless computing.
You have 2+ years of experience as a solutions engineer advising or consulting engineering teams.
You have 4+ years of experience building and launching frontend applications using Next.js or React.
You speak German and/or French; spoken fluency in at least one of them, alongside professional English, is essential for this role.
You have worked with or within agencies, systems integrators, or consulting firms, and understand how they staff, deliver, and grow a technology practice.
You are experienced in developer relations, from training sessions and talks to producing technical content.

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

We are s eeking a Security Solutions Engineer with a strong background in strategic solution evaluation, vendor assessment, and hands-on Proof-of-Concept (PoC) validation. This role is a crucial bridge between identifying customer security requirement s and implementing best-in-class, enterprise-grade solutions. You will be responsible for defining the criteria, researching the market, and executing technical validation for all major security tooling and services adopted by the c ompany .

Threat-to-Solution Mapping: Proactively analyze customer expectations, regulatory/compliance drivers, and threat models to define precise functional and non-functional requirements for new security solutions.
Market Analysis & Scouting: Conduct thorough market scans to identify cutting-edge security products, platforms, and vendors across key domains (e.g., CSPM/CNAPP, DLP, IAM/IGA, EDR/XDR, data security, Kubernetes security, and AI/ML security).
Vendor Due Diligence: Evaluate potential vendors based on technical capability, security posture, integration requirements, roadmap, data residency/compliance, and support quality, and shortlist candidates for the PoC phase.
2. Technical Validation & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Leadership
PoC Planning & Design: Develop detailed, objective, and threat-aligned test plans and success criteria for all security solution Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs), including quantitative success metrics, coverage of key attack scenarios, and opportunities for automation.
Hands-on Environment Setup: Independently architect and deploy isolated PoC environments that accurately simulate our production infrastructure (e.g., setting up cloud VPCs, Kubernetes clusters, integrating with test data via IaC, and mimicking typical workloads).
Testing & Analysis: Execute security research methodologies within the PoC (e.g., simulating attack scenarios, conducting deep feature validation, assessing false positive/negative rates) to rigorously test the vendor solution's effectiveness.
Artifact Generation: Document all findings, including technical performance data, integration challenges, security gaps discovered, and clear comparative analysis metrics.
3. Decision Support & Communication
Recommendation & Insight: Deliver comprehensive, data-driven reports and compelling presentations to security and product leadership and engineering stakeholders, providing a clear recommendation for the optimal solution and vendor selection.
Integration Planning: Work closely with Security Engineering, Platform/Infra, and DevOps teams to ensure selected solutions are feasible to integrate, operate, and scale, and to hand off PoC learnings into implementation plans.

Experience: Minimum 6+ years in Security Engineering, Security Architecture, or a dedicated Security Research role focused on solution validation and vendor management.
Technical Depth: Deep understanding of modern cloud security principles (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP security models, Kubernetes/containers, network segmentation, IaC scanning, least privilege, identity-centric security, confidential computing).
Programming and Automation - Strong scripting / programming skills (e.g., Python, Go, or similar) for automating PoCs, building test harnesses, and integrating tools via APIs and CI/CD pipelines.
Solutions Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience with the architecture, deployment, and testing of two or more enterprise-grade security tools (e.g., SIEM/SOAR platforms, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Vulnerability Management, Secrets Management).
PoC Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to plan and execute complex technical Proof-of-Concepts, including setting up test environments and defining quantitative success metrics.
Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business risk and strategic recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication.

Experience in a compliance-focused industry (e.g., finance, healthcare, or cloud infrastructure) and familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR.

As an MSP Solutions Consultant, you will help managed service providers successfully operationalize and grow their AvePoint MSP solutions. You will take the partner journey beyond the initial solution design and guide implementation, service readiness, adoption and continuous improvement.
This is a hands-on consulting role combining technical delivery with partner enablement and change management. You will work directly with MSP teams to translate a solution or proposition into a repeatable managed service that creates measurable value for the partner and its customers.
This role will have a strong focus on AvePoint Elements, our MSP platform, and the successful candidate will develop deep expertise in supporting partners with its adoption, enablement, and ongoing success.
What you will be doing

· Lead onboarding, implementation and adoption engagements for AvePoint MSP solutions, remotely and on-site where required.

· Help partners turn AvePoint capabilities into standardized, scalable and repeatable managed-service offerings across multiple customer tenants.

· Assess a partner’s technical environment, operating model and service goals, then define a practical roadmap toward production readiness and adoption.

· Configure and validate AvePoint solutions in alignment with partner requirements and the relevant Microsoft cloud environment.

· Guide partners across Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune and Microsoft Entra ID dependencies that influence successful service delivery.

· Deliver workshops, training and coaching for technical, operational and customer-facing partner teams.

· Support change management by aligning stakeholders, addressing adoption barriers and helping partners embed the solution into daily operations.

· Create implementation plans, technical documentation, operational guidance and reusable service-delivery assets.

· Set clear expectations, manage actions and dependencies, and maintain momentum through go-live and post-implementation adoption.

· Act as the partner advocate by bringing structured feedback, product gaps and field insights to AvePoint product and engineering teams.

· Collaborate with Partner Development, Presales, Support and other AvePoint teams to provide a consistent partner experience.

· Support demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical consultations when they help move a partner toward implementation or expansion.
How success will be measured

· Partners can independently operate, support and scale the AvePoint solution across their customer base.

· The agreed solution and service proposition are actively adopted, not only technically deployed.

· Partners use standardized policies, baselines and operational processes across multiple customer tenants.

· Implementation risks, dependencies and customer actions are identified early and managed transparently.

· Partner teams can clearly explain the value of the service and confidently bring it to their customers.

· Feedback from the field is documented and converted into improvements for enablement, delivery and product experience.
What you will bring
You are a consultant who understands how an MSP operates and enjoys combining technology, advisory work and knowledge transfer. You can move between architecture, configuration, stakeholder conversations and practical delivery without losing sight of the partner’s business outcome.

· At least 2 years of experience working within an MSP environment, including exposure to managing multiple customer tenants.

· Approximately 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Microsoft 365 and/or Azure consulting, implementation or engineering.

· Hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas: Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Autopilot or cloud security.

· Experience guiding customers or partners through implementation, operational change and adoption.

· Ability to standardize policies, configurations or service baselines across multiple customer environments.

· Strong consulting and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and overcome resistance with clear technical reasoning.

· Ability to explain complex technical topics in a practical and understandable way to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Business-level Dutch and strong professional English.

· Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple partner engagements and priorities.

· Willingness to travel when an on-site engagement adds value.

· Recent Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, AZ-104, MS-700, or equivalent predecessor certifications.

· Experience presenting, training, coaching or creating technical enablement content.

· Experience building or improving managed-service propositions, operational runbooks or multi-tenant service standards.

· Familiarity with IT governance, security, compliance or service-management principles.
